summary: LGL Group filed an 8-K announcing its transferable subscription rights (Rights Offering) will begin trading on OTC Markets under 'LGLGR' starting June 29, 2026, after previously trading on NYSE American. The Rights Offering commenced June 8, 2026; each Right entitles the holder to purchase one share of common stock at $6.90 per share, with an oversubscription privilege. Expiration is July 15, 2026; no fractional shares are issued. The board supports the offering; Computershare acts as subscription agent. No premium is stated. Watch for market reaction to the OTC listing and participation rate; risk-arb focuses on subscription uptake and any regulatory or price volatility affecting the exercise period.
